scope: three census controls; other annual denominators undefined

target.denominator: full official census control by year
target.separate_operational_denominator: known selected nonaggregate physical settlement population
target.territory_reference_point_metric: included in primary operational spatial measure by user decision; scope and reference-point role explicit; exclusive parent-or-child hierarchy
target.atomic_settlement_coverage: retained as a separate mandatory measure, not replaced or relabeled

wikidata_primary_extension.reuse: reviewed C physical-city semantics, extend applicability to PGT/rural types
gates: exact native code to unique QID
exact name or separately reviewed name variant
no competing identity or unhandled place event
not_universal_prerequisites: literal P131 label equals ADM1 label
within 1 km of another provider point
wikidata_primary_extension.region_context: P625 expected ADM1 check is coarse consistency evidence; copied source_region is not independent evidence
wikidata_primary_extension.mixed_type_lineage: check actual physical meaning; neither blanket acceptance nor blanket administrative-class veto
wikidata_primary_extension.multiple_points: retain alternatives; select a sourced point only through reviewed rule or specific resolution; do not average
wikidata_primary_extension.known_holds: preserve and exclude from application unless separately resolved; distance alone is a risk flag, not proof of wrong object
claim_limits: modern representative point and explicit spatial continuity
no upgrade of external-provider ID binding

conditions: exact physical name/type/region and unique candidate

sampling.pilot: fixed probability/stratified sample plus separately labeled targeted risk and high-population checks
sampling.population_error_estimation: separate frozen PPS with replacement; preserve draw multiplicities

work_priority.small_exception_work: only as needed for 99% population or system-risk resolution
work_priority.wikidata_history: all nondeprecated P1082 statements from full entities, with P585 precision, qualifiers, ranks, references; no primary-census replacement
work_priority.wikidata_history_display: dated nondeprecated secondary claims may be shown with explicit source-quality and scope limitations; ambiguous dates retained; no automatic census or historical identity assignment
